build_blur_transform: build a python module to apply Gaussian blur to a PIL image using BlurTransform with a configurable radius sampler
build_rotate_transform: build a python module to rotate a PIL image by a configurable angle using RotateTransform with a sampler
build_jpeg_compress_transform: build a python module to apply JPEG compression artifacts to a PIL image using JpegCompressTransform with a quality sampler
build_maybe_apply_transform: build a python module to conditionally apply a transform to a PIL image with a given probability using MaybeApplyTransform
build_resize_long_edge_transform: build a python module to resize the long edge of a PIL image to a target size using ResizeLongEdge
